title: LCP Motor Vehicle Accident Vertical Schema
description: Motor-vehicle-accident lead attributes. Exact medical, contractual, and evidentiary documents stay in the post and authenticated attachment store; pings expose only controlled bands and qualification flags.

accident_date_band.description: Age band of the accident; never expose an exact date in a ping.

accident_date.description: Exact accident date. Post-only; never include in a ping.

jurisdiction.description: State, province, or territory where the accident occurred. Prefer core location for the consumer's current location.

injury_present.description: Injury indicator is sensitive health/legal data; post-only.

injury_severity_band.description: Injury severity is sensitive health/legal data; post-only.

medical_treatment.description: Medical treatment is sensitive health data; post-only.

emergency_services_called.description: Emergency-response information is sensitive incident data; post-only.

police_report_available.description: Police-report availability is sensitive incident data; post-only.

fault_position.description: Fault position is sensitive legal/liability data; post-only.

other_driver_identified.description: Other-party identification status is sensitive incident data; post-only.

other_driver_insured.description: Other-party insurance status is sensitive insurance data; post-only.

consumer_insured.description: Consumer insurance status is sensitive insurance data; post-only.

represented_by_attorney.description: Attorney-representation status is sensitive legal data; post-only.

prior_attorney_consultation.description: Prior legal consultation is sensitive legal data; post-only.

claim_filed.description: Claim status is sensitive legal/insurance data; post-only.

evidence_available.description: Presence indicators only. The actual records are represented by encrypted attachments.

additional_context.description: Free text may contain sensitive information and is post-only.
